scope: Isolated local SQLite and deterministic tool/turn transactions, including real calendar writes rolled back by injected deadline/receipt failures. No external provider called.
verified_behavior: Each instrumented administrative tool has a monotonic duration and fixed outcome label; no argument/result/exception text enters traces.
Successful receipts and spans commit atomically; replay returns the receipt without another span.
Handled failure/deadline spans survive rollback; unexpected failed attempts retain call-only metadata after rollback and lease release.
Queued external calendar operations are not classified as completed tool results or confirmed bookings.
Call traces and successful per-tool percentiles are tenant scoped; failed, queued and rolled-back attempts are excluded from success percentiles.
limits: These are local-dispatch subspans, not external queue wait, streaming model inference or physical speaker playback.
No generative language model stage exists in this deterministic engine.
Process death or inability to persist metadata can leave an unobserved attempt; only instrumented persisted events are claimed.
Physical-receiver first-audible distributions and target-network acoustic SLOs remain unverified.
peer_review: blueprint_review read-only pass; no blocking transaction/privacy defect identified; no independent runtime rerun by reviewer.
